3. Plaintiff's case put in a nutshell is that suit land originally belonged to five brothers namely Mozaffar Ahmed, Jafor Ahmed, Saleh Ahmed; Farook Ahmed and Sultan Ahmed in equal share. R.S. Khatian no.240 prepared in their names. Subsequently by amicable partition the suit land appertaining to R.S. plot no. 1154 of schedule -2 devolved solely upon Muzaffar Ahmed who gave it oral settlement to his father without any dakhila, however he was paying rents. Subsequently R.S. and M.R.R. record were prepared in the name of Muzaffar Ahmed. He, by inheritance has been exercising his right, title and possession in suit land more than 12 years. But the defendants taking the advantage of wrong record threatening him to dispossess from suit land. Hence the suit. 

 4. Defendant nos. 1-5 contested the suit by tiling written statement denying all material allegations made in plaint contending interalia that the suit land was belonged, to above live brothers. R.S. khatian no.240 was rightly prepared in their names. Mozaffar Ahmed used the suit land alone as per amicable partition. Accordingly M.R.R. and B.S. khatians were prepared in his name. After the death of Mozaffar Ahmed his share devolved upon his heirs and they are exercising their right, title and possession in suit land on payment of rents. The plaintiff has no right, title and possession in suit land. Therefore, the suit having no cause of action is h to be dismissed. 

 11. Ongoing to materials on record it transpires that suit land was belonged to five brothers namely Mozaffar Ahmed; Jafor Ahmed, Saleh Ahmed, Farook Ahmed and Sultan Ahmed in equal share. R. S. khatian no. 240 was prepared in their names, but Mozaffar Ahmed alone used the suit land by amicable partition. Plaintiff claims that his father took oral settlement of suit land from Mozaffar Ahmed but subsequent khatians were wrongly prepared in his name. The contesting defendants disowned such facts, their claim are that they as heirs of Mozaffar Ahmed are exercising their right, 'title; interest arid possession in suit land.
